Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 1: taxable interest
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 1411(c)(1)(A)(i): NII includes "gross income from interest, dividends, annuities, royalties, and rents". i8960 (2026 draft) p. 7 (PDF p. 8), Line 1: "Enter your taxable interest. Include the applicable amount from your return: Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 2b." interest /interestIncome is Form 1040 line 2b. Interest earned in the ordinary course of a non-section 1411 trade or business (line 7 adjustment) can only arise with a Schedule C, which /flowKnockoutForm8960Unsupported stops.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 2: ordinary dividends
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 1411(c)(1)(A)(i) ("dividends"). i8960 (2026 draft) p. 7 (PDF p. 8), Line 2: "Enter your ordinary dividends. Include the applicable amount from your return: Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 3b." Wired to income /ordinaryDividends (Form 1040 line 3b; $0 until the dividends epic lands), so the line follows automatically when 1099-DIV is supported.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 3: annuities
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 1411(c)(5): NII "shall not include any distribution from a plan or arrangement described in section 401(a), 403(a), 403(b), 408, 408A, or 457(b)." i8960 (2026 draft) p. 8 (PDF p. 9), Line 3: "Amounts subject to NIIT should be identified with code D in box 7a. If code D is shown in box 7a of Form 1099-R, enter the taxable amount reported in box 2a of Form 1099-R on Form 8960, line 3." The 1099-R module accepts only box 7 codes 2, 7, G, H, B and 4G (form1099Rs /hasUnsupportedDistributionCode); any code D 1099-R is stopped by /knockoutForForm1099RDistributionCode (BlockSubmissionOnTrue), so a return that reaches submission has no line 3 amount. $0 by construction, not a default.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 4a: rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, trusts, trades or businesses
Fact.Description: i8960 (2026 draft) p. 8 (PDF p. 9), Line 4a: "Enter the applicable amounts from your return. Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 3. Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 5. Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 6." Schedule 1 line 3 is scheduleC /scheduleCNetProfitOrLoss and line 5 is scheduleE /scheduleENetIncome (income /otherIncome); line 6 (farm) is not supported. Whenever either is present and MAGI is over the threshold, the line 4b trade-or-business adjustment can't be computed and /flowKnockoutForm8960Unsupported stops the return.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 4c
Fact.Description: f8960 (2026 draft) line 4c: "Combine lines 4a and 4b". Line 4b ("Adjustment for net income or loss derived in the ordinary course of a non-section 1411 trade or business included on line 4a") requires the 26 U.S.C. 1411(c)(2) passive-activity / trading classification, which is not collected: when line 4a can be nonzero and the threshold is exceeded, /flowKnockoutForm8960Unsupported stops the return. Line 4b is therefore never used on a submitted return with tax on Form 8960, and line 4c = line 4a.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 5a: net gain or loss from disposition of property
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 1411(c)(1)(A)(iii): "net gain (to the extent taken into account in computing taxable income) attributable to the disposition of property". i8960 (2026 draft) p. 9 (PDF p. 10), Line 5a: "Figure and enter your net gain or loss from the disposition of property by combining the following amounts from your return. Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a, and Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 4." income /capitalGainsOrLosses is the Form 1040 capital gain or loss line (after the 26 U.S.C. 1211(b) loss limit). Schedule 1 line 4 (Form 4797) is not supported. Line 5b (gain on property held in a non-section 1411 trade or business) can only arise with a Schedule C or Schedule E, which /flowKnockoutForm8960Unsupported stops; line 5c (partnership interests and S corporation stock) needs K-1 data, stopped by scheduleE /flowKnockoutScheduleEPartII. So line 5d = line 5a.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 8: total investment income
Fact.Description: f8960 (2026 draft) line 8: "Total investment income. Combine lines 1, 2, 3, 4c, 5d, 6, and 7." Line 5d = line 5a (see /form8960Line5a). Line 6 (CFC and PFIC adjustments) and line 7 (other modifications) have no source in the app: CFC/PFIC holdings, self-charged interest and non-section 1411 business interest aren't collected, and the business cases are stopped by /flowKnockoutForm8960Unsupported.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 10: additional modifications
Fact.Description: f8960 (2026 draft) line 10: "Additional modifications (see instructions)". i8960 (2026 draft) p. 13 (PDF p. 14): "Note: The early withdrawal penalty reported on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 18, is reported on Form 8960, line 10." Treas. Reg. 1.1411-4(f)(2)(iii) (https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/26/1.1411-4): "Penalty on early withdrawal of savings. Deductions described in section 62(a)(9) are taken into account in determining net investment income". Line 10 = interest /earlyWithdrawalPenaltyTotal (Schedule 1 line 18). The other line 10 items (section 62(a)(4) rent and royalty deductions, section 62(a)(1) deductions of a section 1411 trade or business, and the section 1411 NOL amount) only arise with Schedule E or Schedule C, which /flowKnockoutForm8960Unsupported stops over the threshold, or are not in the app (no NOL deduction).

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 11: total deductions and modifications
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 1411(c)(1)(B): NII is reduced by "the deductions allowed by this subtitle which are properly allocable to such gross income or net gain". f8960 (2026 draft) line 11: "Total deductions and modifications. Add lines 9d and 10." i8960 (2026 draft) p. 18 (PDF p. 19), Line 9a: "Enter on Form 8960, line 9a, the interest expense you paid or accrued during the tax year deducted on Schedule A (Form 1040), line 9." Line 9b: "Include state, local, and foreign income taxes you paid for the tax year that are attributable to NII ... See the Instructions for Schedule A (Form 1040)". 1411(c)(1)(B) is not limited to itemized deductions. Treas. Reg. 1.1411-4(f) (https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/26/1.1411-4): (f)(1)(i) "only properly allocable deductions described in this paragraph (f) may be taken into account"; (f)(2) "Properly allocable deductions described in section 62" are section 62(a)(4) deductions allocable to rents and royalties, section 62(a)(1) deductions of a 1.1411-5 trade or business, (f)(2)(iii) "Penalty on early withdrawal of savings. Deductions described in section 62(a)(9) are taken into account in determining net investment income", and the (f)(2)(iv) section 1411 NOL amount. Lines 9a-9c come from Schedule A, so for a filer who takes the standard deduction (taxCalculations /wantsStandardDeduction) lines 9a-9d are $0. An itemizer over the threshold is stopped by /flowKnockoutForm8960Unsupported (the allocation and the Lines 9 and 10 Section 68 Limitation Worksheet, i8960 p. 19, are not modeled). So line 11 = line 9d ($0) + line 10 (/form8960Line10, the Schedule 1 line 18 early withdrawal penalty).

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 12: net investment income
Fact.Description: f8960 (2026 draft) line 12: "Net investment income. Subtract Part II, line 11, from Part I, line 8. Individuals, complete lines 13-17. ... If zero or less, enter -0-".

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 13: modified adjusted gross income
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 1411(d): MAGI "means adjusted gross income increased by the excess of" the section 911(a)(1) exclusion over the related deductions. i8960 (2026 draft) p. 21 (PDF p. 22), Line 13: "If you didn't exclude any amounts from your gross income under section 911 and you don't own an interest in a CFC or PFIC, your MAGI is your AGI as reported on Form 1040 or 1040-SR." Form 2555 and CFC/PFIC interests are not collected anywhere in the app, so MAGI = taxCalculations /agi (Form 1040 line 11).

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 14: threshold based on filing status
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 1411(b): "the term 'threshold amount' means- (1) in the case of a taxpayer making a joint return under section 6013 or a surviving spouse (as defined in section 2(a)), $250,000, (2) in the case of a married taxpayer (as defined in section 7703) filing a separate return, 1/2 of the dollar amount determined under paragraph (1), and (3) in any other case, $200,000." Not indexed for inflation (fixed statutory amounts; no cost-of-living clause in 1411(b)). Cross-check, i8960 (2026 draft) p. 22 (PDF p. 23), Line 14: MFJ $250,000; QSS $250,000; MFS $125,000; Single or Head of household $200,000. The dollar amounts are the interest-module facts /netInvestmentIncomeThresholdForMfjOrQss, /netInvestmentIncomeThresholdForMfs and /netInvestmentIncomeThresholdForSingleOrHoh, which cite 1411(b).

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 15
Fact.Description: f8960 (2026 draft) line 15: "Subtract line 14 from line 13. If zero or less, enter -0-". 26 U.S.C. 1411(a)(1)(B): "the excess (if any) of- (i) the modified adjusted gross income for such taxable year, over (ii) the threshold amount."

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 16
Fact.Description: f8960 (2026 draft) line 16: "Enter the smaller of line 12 or line 15". 26 U.S.C. 1411(a)(1): "a tax equal to 3.8 percent of the lesser of- (A) net investment income for such taxable year, or (B) the excess (if any) of" MAGI over the threshold amount.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 17: net investment income tax for individuals
Fact.Description: f8960 (2026 draft) line 17: "Net investment income tax for individuals. Multiply line 16 by 3.8% (0.038). Enter here and include on your tax return". 26 U.S.C. 1411(a)(1): "a tax equal to 3.8 percent". i8960 (2026 draft) p. 22 (PDF p. 23), Line 17: "If you file Form 1040 or 1040-SR, include this amount on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 6." Rounded to whole dollars like the other Schedule 2 lines.

Fact.Name: MAGI is over the Form 8960 threshold
Fact.Description: Form 8960 line 13 is greater than line 14 (26 U.S.C. 1411(a)(1)(B)).

Fact.Name: Form 8960 is required
Fact.Description: i8960 (2026 draft) p. 1 (PDF p. 2), Who Must File: "Attach Form 8960 to your return if your modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) is greater than the applicable threshold amount."

Fact.Name: Knockout: Net Investment Income Tax that Direct File can't compute
Fact.Description: No silent zeros on Form 8960. When MAGI is over the 26 U.S.C. 1411(b) threshold, stop the return if it has any of: (1) a Schedule C business (Schedule 1 line 3, Form 8960 line 4a). Whether its income is NII depends on 1411(c)(1)(A)(ii) and (c)(2) ("a passive activity (within the meaning of section 469) with respect to the taxpayer" or trading in financial instruments or commodities), the line 4b adjustment (i8960 (2026 draft) p. 8, Line 4b), 1411(c)(6) (items taken into account for SE income) and line 5b/7 business carve-outs. None of these classifications are collected. (2) Schedule E Part I rents or royalties (Schedule 1 line 5, line 4a). Rents and royalties are NII under 1411(c)(1)(A)(i) "other than such income which is derived in the ordinary course of a trade or business not described in paragraph (2)"; the rental trade-or-business / real estate professional / grouping rules and the 469 passive-loss interaction aren't modeled. (Parts II-IV K-1 income from partnerships, S corporations, estates and trusts is already stopped by scheduleE /flowKnockoutScheduleEPartII.) (3) itemized deductions (scheduleA /itemizesDeductions): Part II lines 9a-9c and 10 allocations (1411(c)(1)(B) "properly allocable"; Treas. Reg. 1.1411-4(f)) and the i8960 Section 68 worksheet aren't modeled. At or under the threshold, line 15 is $0, so line 17 is $0 whatever line 12 is, and nothing is stopped.
